scope: Decision-level ablation on first turns only, using the same observed V2 online risk and current query. Cues-only activates quoted_context_check/masked_recovery, IA-only activates report/article plus specified Yes/No/Unknown format, full activates both.
base: V2 action when valid risk is low; failures and high-risk decisions preserve V2 behavior.
metrics: first-turn intervention count by traffic and predicted cue
normal interventions and low-risk attack triggers
limits: No new model responses or complete multi-turn policy simulations are created.
Second and later turns are excluded because changed prior delivery can alter session risk and history.
This isolates decision rules, not independent causal estimates of end-to-end attack success.
